# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::markdown`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

The markdown preview (`text.markdown-preview`, D12): a block model drawn in a window.

The toolkit draws the model and interprets none of it: no parse, no HTML, no fetch. An image is
a picture the app decoded and registered ([`MdImage`](markdown.md#struct.MdImage)); a remote target is never asked for. A
link raises the app's [`MdResponse::link`](markdown.md#structfield.MdResponse.link) and the app opens it; a task box raises
[`MdResponse::task`](markdown.md#structfield.MdResponse.task) and the model keeps its value until the app changes it.

The top-level blocks are the virtual rows of a [scroll area](scroll_area.md): heights are
estimated until a block is built, then what it measured, and a block above the first in view that
changes height moves the area by as much, so what is on screen stays. A block's inside is built
whole. One layout function serves measuring and drawing (`Cx::draw`), so the two cannot differ.

Inline text is one rich [`Spec`](../text.md#struct.Spec) per block: bold, italic, links and inline code are runs. An
inline code run is padded with two U+2009 either side, which draws its pill's padding; the pads
are stripped from Copy and from the node by offset. The pills, strike bars and link underlines
are fills from the text's row boxes, because the text seam has no decoration of its own.

  The accessible name of the document.

  A click on a task box reports its id. Off, the boxes only show the model.

- <a id="structfield.MdOptions.identity"></a>`pub identity: Option<u64>`

  The app's "same document" key. A new one is another document: it starts at the top, the
  measured heights go, and so does everything its blocks kept: a selection, the focus, a table's
  or code block's sideways offset. Going back to a key is a new document too.
